channel.title: Podbean Amplified
channel.description:
The podcast for podcasters, by podcasters. Podcast Amplified is the official in-house podcast by Podbean with podcasting interviews, best practices and helpful tips.
Podbean is a podcast publishing and monetization service, hosting almost 600,000 podcasts. If you’re looking to start your own podcast, monetize your podcast and livestream directly to your listeners, you can set up an account at podbean.com
To contact Podcasting Amplified with questions get in contact at shaer@podbean.com
channel.itunes:author: Podbean

item.title: Episode 11 | Tales From The Trip!
item.itunes:title: Episode 11 | Tales From The Trip!
item.description:
Every podcast has a journey—and every journey has stories worth telling. On Podbean Amplified Episode 11, we sit down with Trip Keeper to talk about creative paths, lessons learned along the way, and the moments that define the trip. From idea to execution, we explore how storytelling, reflection, and experience shape meaningful content.

If you’ve ever wondered how creators stay grounded while building something impactful, this episode is for you.

item.title: Podbean Amplified Ep. 10 | Where Customer Success Becomes Growth
item.itunes:title: Podbean Amplified Ep. 10 | Where Customer Success Becomes Growth
item.description:
What happens when customer success and marketing actually work together? You get growth that lasts.

In Episode 10 of Podbean Amplified, we sit down with Mark Pafume, VP of Customer Success and seasoned marketing leader, to talk about the strategies that turn users into loyal advocates and products into long-term platforms.

Mark shares real insights from the front lines — where customer experience, retention, and brand growth all collide.

If you're a creator, marketer, or podcast host looking to grow not just your audience — but your community — this one’s for you. Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more conversations with leaders shaping the future of podcasting and creator growth.

item.title: Podbean Amplified Ep.9 | Building Community Through Podcasting
item.itunes:title: Podbean Amplified Ep.9 | Building Community Through Podcasting
item.description:
At Circling the Wagons, community is at the heart of every conversation.

In this episode, we explore how podcasting has evolved into one of the most impactful ways to build authentic, engaged communities. Through our interview-driven format, Circling the Wagons brings together podcasters, creators, and industry voices to share real stories, lived experiences, and practical insights—creating space for meaningful dialogue both on and off the mic.

We discuss:

  • How podcasts turn conversations into communities

  • The role of shared experiences in audience engagement

  • Ways podcasters can foster belonging beyond the episode release

Whether you’re launching a podcast or looking to deepen your audience relationships, this episode breaks down why community is the true measure of podcast success.

Tune in to learn how intentional conversations can create lasting connections through podcasting.
